snippet.title: VR Giants - Official Meta Quest Early Access Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Meta Quest Early Access Release Date Trailer for VR Giants, a VR 3D platforming co-op game developed by Risa Interactive. Players will work in tandem with a friend playing on controller to use their VR prespective to support them through challenging levels. VR Giants is launching into Early Access on December 11 for Meta Quest.
